gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-yuji-boku: Ruler-straight strokes and gaping gaps in the e give Happy Monkey a bold, slightly goofy swagger. Yuji Boku follows in a classic serif that holds each line to one thickness, with a wide-open c that keeps a long page easy on the eye.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-nunito-sans: Bold and a bit odd, Happy Monkey bends every letter like thin steel rod, while Nunito Sans stays low and soft beneath it. One shouts, one murmurs, and nothing fights.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-bree-ser: Expressive and loose, Love Ya Like A Sister sets its letters low with no shading from thick to thin. Bree Serif then carries on in outsized lowercase, so a longer passage feels refined and bookish rather than busy.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-port-lli: Love Ya Like A Sister looks like thin plastic tubing bent into loops. Port Lligat Slab sits next to it with wide, porthole-round counters and hugging shapes, so the two feel like a playful friend beside a traditional serif.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-quando: Quando spreads its sparse, wide-spaced letters across a big, tall middle zone in every word. But Love Ya Like A Sister is the one that shows off, its tube-like strokes holding thickness through every bend while the text serif simply keeps the words readable.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-rowan: Metamorphous sets its letters with generous sidebearings and a high midline, giving headings a commanding, slightly theatrical look. And Rowan brings a friendlier, literary warmth, its open curves and moderate lowercase height making the strongest quality of the pair a gentle step down in volume.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-almendra: Almendra reads as dignified and bookish, with a deep midsection in the lowercase that fills each line with weight. Metamorphous above it keeps its stroke modulation tempered, so paragraphs flow without strain.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-bree-serif: Stately up top, sturdy below. Metamorphous holds thicks and thins in moderation, and Bree Serif answers with outsized lowercase, so the strongest quality here is a shared literary, refined feel at two different volumes.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-port-lligat-slab: Large sidebearings and a high-set midline mark Metamorphous as the commanding voice, though its line stays restful with modest swings in weight. Port Lligat Slab lets the text serif's porthole-wide counters and hugging letters carry the page below.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-quando: Metamorphous brings a calm ebb and flow of stroke thickness, with a high midline and roomy sidebearings. Quando holds the other end, its sparse spacing and tall middle zone making the pair's strongest quality a clear, bookish step down from a commanding heading.
